summary.result: On the other hand, T-P and $COD_{Cr}$ , were released three days after tillering fertilization.
summary.background: The pollutant concentrations at experimental paddy plots with three (excessive, standard, reduced) different fertilization rates were investigated during 2001-2002 irrigation seasons.
summary.method: The T-N concentrations decreased but the concentrations of T-P and $COD_{Cr}$ , increased three days after tillering fertilization.
